name: Valley of Honor
summary: In the Valley of Honor, Orgrimmar's warriors and hunters prepare for battle. Its barracks, guilds, and battlemasters serve the Horde's forces across Azeroth, while forges and training grounds keep its fighters ready.

sections.title: Heart of the Horde's Might
sections.body: The Valley of Honor holds Orgrimmar's military quarter behind high canyon ridges. Practice weapons clash, and blacksmiths' anvils ring through the day. The Hall of the Brave draws seasoned warriors and battlemasters who coordinate campaigns in places such as Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch. Training grounds for beastmasters and hunters flank the hall. Across the valley, the Horde equips, drills, and sends out its frontline defenders.

sections.title: Craft, Trade, and Respite
sections.body: The valley supplies arms and offers a place to rest between duties. The Burning Anvil and Red Canyon Mining provide armor and raw iron, while engineers work nearby in Nogg's Machine Shop. Grunts and visiting adventurers can fish in a quiet pool, taking a brief pause from the dust of the Valley of Strength.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Valley of Honor?
faq.answer: The Valley of Honor is Orgrimmar's military hub. Its barracks, warrior and hunter trainers, weaponsmiths, and battlemasters support the Horde's forces and send soldiers to major battlefronts.

faq.q: Where can I find battlemasters in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Horde battlemasters gather inside the Hall of the Brave in the Valley of Honor. They enlist soldiers and send them to ongoing battles across Azeroth.

faq.q: What professions are trained in the Valley of Honor?
faq.answer: The Valley of Honor has trainers and supply vendors for blacksmithing, mining, and fishing. Goblin engineering specialists work from Nogg's Machine Shop.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can find the Hall of the Brave, veteran combat instructors, and armorers who forge the Horde's front lines in the Valley of Honor.
As a hunter, you can visit the Hunter's Hall and beast-taming grounds to replenish ammunition, hone your marksmanship, and stable your companions.
